title: Numerical-Decidability-Gated Metamorphic Testing for SciML Surrogates
description: Replication package for the manuscript "Numerical-Decidability-Gated Metamorphic Testing for SciML Surrogates" prepared for Journal of Systems and Software regular-paper submission. Contains the admissibility rubric, MR-card executable assets, the claim ledger binding every reported result to a tracked artifact, the MeshGraphNets cylinder-flow case study with committed run artifacts, airfoil, periodic-advection, PINN/FNO, external witness, and cross-program evidence, the manuscript source (Elsevier elsarticle), the regression test suite and fail-closed validators, and reproducibility tiers with a Dockerfile. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
